$comment: Where the maintainers of named color schemes publish hand-tuned files per app. `repo` and `dir` may contain {app}; `tmt parts port` tries the app id, then with _ for -, then with no -. Any scheme not listed falls back to `any` (iTerm2-Color-Schemes, 1,000+ schemes exported per terminal). Checked against the GitHub trees on 2026-11-23.
